name: Niji no Majo to Enogu no Ouji-sama
original_name: 虹の魔女と絵の具の王子様
source:
The protagonist is a witch who lives in a painted land.
But she is very bad at using magic, and whenever she fails, she causes rain to fall.

One day, the protagonist was practicing magic, but once again, the magic fails and rain starts to fall. While drearily taking shelter from the rain in the forest, she met a boy with black hair and black eyes.

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16780]Freem![/url]]
